save.heading: Your save file
save.explain: Progress lives in a file you keep. Download it after a run and load it next time you play.

save.not_json: That file is not a save file: it could not be read as JSON.
save.wrong_game: That file is a save from another game. Choose a Galactic Survivors save.
save.wrong_version: That save comes from a different version of the game and cannot be loaded here.
save.damaged: That save is missing parts the game needs. Choose another file.

settings.autoaim.about: Rail Bolt, Cutting Beam and Lance Array normally fire toward your pointer. With this on, they aim at the nearest enemy instead.
settings.motion.about: Turns off hit flashes, growing rings and the salvage reveal. The camera never shakes either way.

help.heading: The controls
help.text: Every ability fires on its own. Your job is to move: dodge shots, stay out of the crowd, and pull enemies into groups your abilities can hit.
help.move.about: WASD or the arrow keys. On a touch screen, drag anywhere to steer.
help.aim.about: Point with the mouse. Only aimed abilities use it, and auto-aim in Settings turns that off.
help.dash.about: Space. Vector only: a short burst that cannot be hit.
help.cards.about: Press 1, 2 or 3, or click a card. R draws a new hand.
help.pause.about: Esc or P pauses a solo run and shows your build. In co-op, I shows your build without pausing.

coop.heading: Play together
coop.explain: One player hosts and gets a room code; the other types it in. If a room code cannot connect, use an invitation instead: the host copies an invitation, the partner pastes it and sends a reply back.
coop.wait_host: Choose your character. The host starts the run.
coop.partner_choosing: Your partner is choosing a card.
coop.code_prompt: Type the room code your host gave you.
coop.invite_prompt: Send this invitation to your partner, then paste their reply below.
coop.reply_prompt: Paste the invitation from your host. A reply will appear for you to send back.

online.waiting: Waiting for your partner to connect.
online.reload: Your partner has a different version of the game. Both of you reload the page, then connect again.
online.garbled: A message from your partner could not be read. If the run stops, leave and connect again.
online.left: Your partner left. The run ended and your rewards were kept.
online.full: That room already has two players.
online.desync: The two games stopped agreeing, so the run ended. Your rewards were kept.
online.no_bundle: The connection code did not load. Reload the page and try again.
online.no_relay: No meeting server answered. Try again, or use an invitation instead of a room code.
online.no_path: The two browsers could not reach each other. This happens on some strict networks; try another network.
online.signal_failed: Setting up the connection failed. Try again.
online.bad_code: That is not a room code. Codes are four to eight letters or digits.

run.busy: Finish or leave the run first.

down.heading: You are down
down.text: Your ghost drops a repair cell for your partner every few seconds. Stand still near your partner's path: they revive you by staying beside you.

card.heading: Level up: choose one
card.banishes: Banishes left: {n}. A banished card stays out of this run.
card.gold.about: Nothing left to learn, so take some gold instead.

results.save_reminder: Your progress is not in a file yet. Download your save before you close the page.

banner.boss: Something large is coming up through the ground
banner.rift_enter: Inside the rift: defeat the Stalker

hud.dash_prompt: Press Space to dash through danger

about.pathfinder: A balanced explorer whose shoulder drone aims for you, and who fires an extra shot at levels ten and twenty.
about.breaker: A heavy bruiser who wades into the crowd. Takes half damage from contact and hurts whatever touches it.
about.vector: A fast, fragile scout who aims with the pointer and can dash through danger.
about.arc_sweep: Sweeps a wide arc toward the thickest part of the crowd.
about.rail_bolt: Fires a piercing bolt toward your pointer.
about.needler: A fan of thin needles that pass through several enemies.
about.ricochet_disc: A disc that bounces from enemy to enemy.
about.ground_slam: Slams the ground around you and throws enemies back.
about.mine_layer: Drops mines that go off when an enemy steps close.
about.cutting_beam: Holds a beam toward your pointer that cuts everything along it.
about.orbit_drones: Drones circle you and hit what they touch.
about.pulse_field: A steady pulse that hurts everything close to you.
about.mortar: Lobs a shell at a random enemy nearby.
about.chain_arc: Lightning that jumps from enemy to enemy.
about.cryo_burst: A cold burst that hurts and slows enemies around you.
about.missiles: Homing missiles that pick their own targets.
about.flamer: A short flame in the direction you are moving.
about.sentry: Places a turret that shoots for a while.
about.swarm_battery: The Seeker Rifle, evolved: a stream of homing rounds.
about.shockwave_maul: The Arc Sweep, evolved: a full circle that hits harder.
about.lance_array: The Rail Bolt, evolved: three lances that pass through everything.
about.halo_guard: Orbit Drones, evolved: six drones that never stop circling.
about.storm_lattice: Chain Arc, evolved: lightning that reaches twelve enemies.
about.hardened_shell: {n} armor per level, taken off every hit.
about.magnet_coil: Pull pickups from {n}% farther away per level.
